record: Six next advisories excepted for the frozen macOS application variant lock under its dedicated OSV config
claim: OSV-Scanner 2.6.0 reports six advisories published 2026-10-07 for next 16.3.5 in the frozen variant lock, all first patched in 16.3.8. Each gets one dated exception in .github/osv-scanner-frozen-macos.toml, which the workflow applies to that lock alone; the lock bytes, the ordinary config and the inventory are unchanged. With the exceptions, the workflow's own scan step exits 0 locally. Reachability is not claimed: the exceptions rest on the absence of a supported consumer of the variant.
ignore_until_basis: The date of the three existing entries in the frozen config, of REVIEW_DATE in tests/test_frozen_macos_variant_no_use.py and of the closure decision's frozen-lock exception; within the 90-day bound tests/test_osv_lockfile_coverage.py enforces (2026-10-07 plus 90 days is 2027-01-05).
authorization: Command-center ruling relayed in the coordinator's brief of 2026-10-07 for this change, the same as the earlier ruling quoted in evidence/receipts/osv-frozen-macos-source-map-js-20261005.json (task-ns2604-coop-20261006T003954Z, ruling1): a dated isolated-config exception per advisory, lock bytes preserved, no exception added to .github/osv-scanner.toml.

scope: Six exceptions only under .github/osv-scanner-frozen-macos.toml, which security-scan.yml applies in an invocation of its own to this one digest-bound inventory entry. .github/osv-scanner.toml and .github/osv-scanner-lockfiles.json are unchanged and hold no next exception.
reachability: Each advisory's precondition is taken from its text (advisory_records). The retained artifact holds no application source or Next.js configuration, so whether the captured application met a precondition is not established here; its package.json declares a dev script that runs next dev, the only mode GHSA-39w2-rjm5-chcv affects. The exceptions rest on non-use: no supported installer, build, server or replay route consuming the variant was found.
limits: Source review and a local scan, not universal unreachability, safe manual replay, fresh application execution or hosted acceptance. The no-use tripwire catches direct references only; indirect loaders, globs, fragmented paths and external commands exceed its demonstrated boundary (tests/test_frozen_macos_variant_no_use.py, Limits). Dependabot alerts come from GitHub's dependency graph, not OSV configs, so any alerts for these advisories on the variant's package.json are outside this change.
overturn: Remove the six exceptions and re-review before manual installation, replay, a new consuming route, adoption, changed lock bytes or 2026-12-24. The .frozen rename remains a separately tracked follow-up.
sanitization: Local scratch paths are written as <scratch>; no credential, token or personal path is recorded.
